title: Birth of Isaac
summary: Isaac is born to Abraham (100) and Sarah (90), as promised (Gen 21:1-7).
description: God visited Sarah and she bore Isaac at the set time of which God had spoken; Abraham was 100 years old (Gen 21:1-5).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 1896 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.note: pending CFAH reference. CFAH-6 Argument 4 §5 states Isaac was "born in 1896 BC" (Ussher-Jones); not an AP or a CFAH-1 Table 1 row.

chronologies.citation: Jones, Chronology of the Old Testament (15th ed., 2002), p. 59 ("1896 BC = 2108 AM Year Isaac is born (Gen.21:5, see Chart 3)")
Ussher, Annals of the World, Third Age §85 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)

chronologies.date: 2108 - In the spring Sarah gives birth to Isaac in Philistine territory (Gen. 21:1-7).
chronologies.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 4)," Biblical Chronology 6:6 (June 1994), §11 "The Life of Abraham" (year list)

chronologies.date: 100 yrs old Abraham; Isaac is born. (21:5) ... 2108 AM
chronologies.citation: Anno Mundi Chronology Studies (unnamed compiler; a compilation of James B. Jordan's system), p. 3, chart "Genesis 12 – 25 Chronology of Abraham’s Life"
chronologies.note: Agrees with Jordan's own published AM 2108.

chronologies.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book II, ch. I, §IIII
chronologies.note: One year more than Ussher. The 1617 text puts Abraham's birth at AM 2008 (Book II, ch. I, §VIII), so 2109 does not follow from "Abraham 100" (Gen 21:5). Raleigh's Jacob (2169), Moses (2434) and flight to Midian (2474) are also one year above Ussher.
